name: g_live_inventory
comment: Native ten-slot live inventory window.

name: g_inventory_boxes
comment: Authoritative four-box backing storage, 40 words total.

name: g_mkmszr_settings
comment: MKMSZR native GAME SETTINGS state word used by production control options.

name: g_xp_cap_table
comment: Native XP cap/threshold-related table used by tier evaluator.

name: g_native_font
comment: Native font data used by text renderer/width helper.

name: g_special_action_lock
comment: Native special-action lock/state used by action lifecycle proofs.

name: g_actor_list_head
comment: Active actor-list head used by actor_list_insert.

name: g_ice_mode
comment: Native Ice mode used by bounded Ice-Blast-to-pickup proof.

name: g_current_xp
comment: Current native XP value.

name: g_stage_acquired_bits
comment: Stage progression/acquired-bit field; exact meanings are stage-context dependent.

name: g_stage_selector
comment: Live stage/checkpoint selector used for spawn/state routing.

name: g_player_controller
comment: Pointer to player controller/process.

name: g_current_controller
comment: Pointer to current controller/process.

name: g_retrace_ticks
comment: Gameplay retrace/tick counter used by scheduler timing.

name: g_audio_frame_count
comment: Native frame counter advanced by sample DMA cleanup.

name: g_audio_command_index
comment: Alternating audio command-list index.

name: g_audio_info_index
comment: Three-way AudioInfo producer index.

name: g_audio_last_info
comment: Previous output AudioInfo submitted on next service; advances despite rejection.

name: g_audio_extra_samples
comment: Native synthesis reserve; captured value 320.

name: g_wess_tick_count
comment: Native WESS callback count; paired states preserve exact sample-clock relation.

name: g_wess_milliseconds
comment: Integer half of native fixed-point millisecond clock.

name: g_wess_millisecond_fraction
comment: Fractional WESS clock component; tick increment 0x85555 in 16.16.

name: g_audio_synth
comment: ALSynth pointer. Signed-low address reconstruction yields 0x800A8210, not 0x800B8210.

name: g_audio_work_enabled
comment: VI-side gate for native audio_frame_work.

name: g_audio_task_fresh
comment: Task generated during previous VI service, promoted next VI.

name: g_audio_task_queued
comment: Single pending audio task pointer; generation replacement under delay is conditional.

name: g_audio_task_active
comment: Active audio task ownership; dispatcher defers while nonzero.

name: g_audio_command_lists
comment: Two native audio command-list pointers.

name: g_audio_info_buffers
comment: Three native AudioInfo pointers; snapshot records have stride 0xB50, PCM at +0x50.

name: g_audio_min_samples
comment: Native frame minimum, captured 352 stereo sample frames.

name: g_audio_target_samples
comment: Native per-service target, captured 368 stereo sample frames.

name: g_audio_max_samples
comment: Configured PCM frame capacity, captured 704 sample frames.

name: g_audio_player_sample_time
comment: Player callback sample time; paired snapshots equal WESS ticks times 184.

name: g_scheduler_message_queue
comment: OSMesgQueue capacity 32, buffer 0x801AE4C8; no endpoint backlog in paired states.

name: g_vi_callback_count
comment: Native input/VI callback counter; do not equate endpoint difference with wall time.
